content_of_post_to_comment: I would love to read interesting personal essays, poems or short stories. Anything unique really haha. My feed is full of criticism or self-help content. I’m tired of the same repetitive thing with every scroll. If you have any feel free to share it in the comments.️
comment: There’s something interesting about the distinction between writing that tries to teach us something and writing that simply lets us experience someone else’s perspective. I think we need more of the latter.
